items.Sentence: The STEP consists of 292 individual septic tanks for primary settling and treatment with septic tank effluent pumped to aerated lagoons and wetland treatment cells prior to disposal in the RIBs.

These facilities consist of a septic tank effluent pump (STEP) collection system, grit removal, grinder pumps, pumping station, metering vault, wet well, odor control, aerated lagoons, wetland treatment cells and disposal in rapid infiltration basins (RIBs).
